judge.reason: X and Y add the same condition-based cachedmethod path. Both mark a key as pending, wait until no other call is computing it, store the result, then remove the key and call notify_all. Both fall back to using cond as the lock when no lock is given. The only behaviour difference is in the finally block: X checks that the key is still pending before removing it, and Y removes it directly. In Y, the key was always added on that path, so the results are the same. Y also rewrites the existing locked and unlocked wrappers around a shared _cachedmethod_with_cache helper that takes a lookup callback,
